title: Review saved family and patient visibility fix
objective: Independently review the root-owned fix that shows the newest complete saved profile consistently across caregiver screens and after saving/reloading.
acceptance_criteria: Newest complete profile selected consistently after reload
Successful server responses update current caregiver context before navigation
Failed patient creation remains retryable without another family
Save failure does not claim success or leave entered fields
required_tests: Root runs setup/resolver regression tests, full frontend suite and targeted lint; reviewer independently inspects code

result.summary: Root ACCEPT for the bounded saved-profile visibility fix. Shared newest-complete resolver, server-response context cache update, saved Family details, dynamic Home names, separate successful-save/back navigation and retry-safe saved-family state implemented. Independent review approved after correcting cancel/back regression. Frontend 26 suites/100 tests and three focused backend profile tests pass; targeted lint passes. Six pre-existing FamilyMember type errors remain. Evidence: .agent-state/handoffs/PROFILE-001.md.
